name: concr
description: CONCR - concrete ordering & delivery platform: customer + driver mobile app, dispatcher web panel, API

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev -w packages/shared" "npm:dev -w apps/api" "npm:dev -w apps/dispatch"
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w apps/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
